profile.headline: AVP - Senior Software Developer at Citi
profile.summary: I am a NYC based software developer with both front-end and back-end experience.

positions.title: AVP - Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Skills: OpenShift · Helm Charts · Java · Amazon EC2 · IBM UrbanCode Deploy (uDeploy) · Apache Kafka · Redis · Amazon ECS · Kubernetes · Tekton CI/CD · Autosys · Spring Boot · Shell Scripting · Amazon S3 · Gradle · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Implemented front-end feature changes and bugfixes for CMO application
• Implemented back-end feature changes and bugfixes in Java and Python for CMO application
• Collaborated with team members to bring wide-reaching full-stack feature changes to completion
• Remediated security violations via Maven and Gradle and brought several existing applications into compliance with up-to-date security standards
• Coordinated releases with remote teams

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Implemented front-end feature changes and bugfixes for CMO application
• Implemented back-end feature changes and bugfixes in Java and Python for CMO application
• Remediated security violations via Maven and Gradle and brought several existing applications into compliance with up-to-date security standards

positions.title: IT Consultant
positions.description:
Received extensive training in:
•  Professional Skills
•  SQL (PL/SQL, nested queries, joins)
•  Unix (functions, parameters, writing shell scripts, loops)
•  JUnit, TDD, UML, and Object Oriented Principles
•  Java Core Fundamentals and Key Tools (Eclipse, SVN, log4j, Mockito, Maven)
•  Java Core (I/O, multithreading)
•  Data Access (using JDBC, JPA)
•  Finance (equities, bonds, derivatives, risk, trade lifecycle)
•  Web Development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, XML)
•  Java Web Applications on Tomcat (Servlets and JSP)
•  Spring Framework (Core, AOP, Web MVC)
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Bash · PL/SQL · Oracle SQL Developer · Spring Framework · Shell Scripting

positions.title: Java Developer Consultant
positions.description:
•	Used java and regex to improve and optimize open source java api—translating json requests to xml, and xml responses to json, with an average translation time of ~2 ms (down from 40~80 ms)
•	Pioneered the use of JMeter for load testing
•	Developed windows batch scripts to automate load testing with JMeter
•	Improved on windows batch scripts, utilized by Jenkins, to automate proprietary testing software usage
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Windows Batch · JMeter · Jenkins · Regex

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description: •	Trained in the development of dynamic web pages, using JSP, to interface with an Oracle database, using Java Servlets
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Oracle SQL · JavaServer Pages (JSP)

positions.title: Front End Developer Intern
positions.description:
•	Implemented responsive web page designs (from PSDs), using HTML5, Bootstrap, JavaScript, Python (Django), jQuery, and CSS3
•	Identified problems uncovered by testing or customer feedback, and corrected or referred problems to appropriate personnel for correction
•	Evaluated code to ensure that it was valid, was properly structured, and was compatible with different browsers
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · HTML5 · Web Development · Bootstrap · JavaScript · CSS 3 · jQuery · Django

positions.title: Quality Assurance Intern
positions.description:
•	Provided feedback and recommendations to developers on software usability and functionality
•	Investigated customer problems referred by technical support
•	Participated in product design reviews to provide input on functional requirements, product designs, and potential problems
•	Identified, analyzed, and documented problems with software function, output, online screen, or content
•	Tested system modifications to prepare for implementation
positions.insights: Skills: Selenium · Web Development · PHP · WordPress
